scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names room-do,app "npm run dev:room-do" "npm run dev:app"
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy --workspace=@prompt-royale/room-do && npm run deploy --workspace=@prompt-royale/app
scripts.build: wrangler deploy --dry-run --minify --outdir dist --config promptroyale-do/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --minify --outdir dist --config promptroyale/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/local.mjs tests/free-limits.mjs
